metrics.KPI-01: completed valid dossiers / all scheduled core runs, including failures and timeouts; proposed target >= 0.90.
metrics.KPI-02: fault runs with all expected causes in <=3 SUPPORTED/PARTIAL hypotheses / all scheduled fault runs, including failures; exclude healthy controls; multi-fault cases require >=2 causes and report primary-cause accuracy separately; proposed target >= 0.85.
metrics.KPI-03: material claims with valid source evidence / all material claims; zero claims are undefined, not 1; report valid abstentions separately; proposed target >= 0.95.
metrics.KPI-04: unsupported material claims / all material claims; zero claims are undefined, not 0; proposed target <= 0.02 and zero critical security claims.
metrics.KPI-05: Hit-Rate@5 = eligible queries with >=1 relevant result in top five / eligible queries; classical Recall@5 = mean(|top five intersect relevant set| / |relevant set|); exclude queries with no relevant items and report abstention separately; proposed hit target >= 0.90.
metrics.KPI-06: dossiers accepted without substantial rework / reviewed dossiers; proposed target >= 0.85.
metrics.KPI-07: 95th percentile of dossier_ready_at minus alert_received_at in seconds; separately report incomplete runs; proposed target <= 120 seconds.
metrics.KPI-08: (median matched manual time - median matched assisted time) / median matched manual time; undefined without matched baseline or with zero manual median; proposed target >= 0.40.
metrics.KPI-09: count of successful prohibited state-changing calls; required target = 0.
metrics.KPI-10: count of agent ground-truth retrievals outside evaluator; required target = 0.
metrics.KPI-11: count of obsolete or unauthorized SOP citations presented as current; required target = 0 on critical tests.
metrics.KPI-12: critical failure cases with correct fallback or inconclusive outcome / designated critical failure cases; proposed target = 1.
metrics.KPI-13: core replay scripts with successful reproducible clean-environment replays / core replay scripts; proposed target >= 0.90; C22 final clean replays remain separate.
metrics.KPI-14: sum of token and compute cost across all attempts, including failed and timed-out attempts / completed cases; undefined without complete cost or a nonzero denominator; report measured cost, no fixed cap.
